notes: Column-store with full SQL:2003 transactions (optimistic concurrency). Bulk load via COPY INTO ... ON CLIENT. Replication: no built-in physical replication in the open-source release (monetdb replication is transaction-log based, experimental).

ddl:
CREATE TABLE customers (
  id INT NOT NULL,
  name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
  email VARCHAR(150) NOT NULL,
  country_code VARCHAR(2) NOT NULL,
  tier VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL,
  created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  attrs JSON,
  PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

CREATE TABLE categories (
  id INT NOT NULL,
  parent_id INT,
  name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
  depth INT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

CREATE TABLE products (
  id INT NOT NULL,
  category_id INT NOT NULL,
  sku VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
  name VARCHAR(150) NOT NULL,
  description TEXT NOT NULL,
  price DECIMAL(12,2) NOT NULL,
  attrs JSON,
  active BOOLEAN NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (id),
  FOREIGN KEY (category_id) REFERENCES categories (id)
)

CREATE TABLE orders (
  id INT NOT NULL,
  customer_id INT NOT NULL,
  status VARCHAR(12) NOT NULL,
  ordered_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  total_amount DECIMAL(14,2) NOT NULL,
  shipping_country VARCHAR(2) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (id),
  FOREIGN KEY (customer_id) REFERENCES customers (id)
)

CREATE TABLE order_items (
  id INT NOT NULL,
  order_id INT NOT NULL,
  product_id INT NOT NULL,
  qty INT NOT NULL,
  unit_price DECIMAL(12,2) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (id),
  FOREIGN KEY (order_id) REFERENCES orders (id),
  FOREIGN KEY (product_id) REFERENCES products (id)
)

CREATE TABLE events (
  id BIGINT NOT NULL,
  customer_id INT NOT NULL,
  event_type VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
  occurred_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  payload JSON,
  value_num DECIMAL(12,4) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

CREATE TABLE inventory (
  product_id INT NOT NULL,
  warehouse_id INT NOT NULL,
  qty INT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (product_id, warehouse_id)
)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ux_customers_email ON customers (email)

msqldump.notes: SQL dump with COPY INTO blocks; the new database is created in the same dbfarm with the monetdb control tool

steps.name: monetdb create lab_restore
steps.cmd: monetdb stop lab_restore >/dev/null 2>&1; monetdb destroy -f lab_restore >/dev/null 2>&1; monetdb create lab_restore && monetdb release lab_restore && printf 'user=monetdb\npassword=monetdb\n' > /tmp/.monetdb-new && DOTMONETDBFILE=/tmp/.monetdb-new mclient -d lab_restore -s "ALTER USER SET PASSWORD 'labpass' USING OLD PASSWORD 'monetdb'"
steps.out:
created database in maintenance mode: lab_restore
taken database out of maintenance mode: lab_restore
operation successful

steps.name: destroy restore db
steps.cmd: monetdb stop lab_restore >/dev/null 2>&1; monetdb destroy -f lab_restore

msqldump.description: SQL dump restored into a second database

hot_snapshot.notes: server-side consistent tar of the database directory (no client round trips); restore = untar under a new name in the dbfarm

steps.name: remove old snapshot db
steps.cmd: monetdb stop lab_snap >/dev/null 2>&1; monetdb destroy -f lab_snap >/dev/null 2>&1; rm -rf /var/monetdb5/dbfarm/lab_snap; true

steps.name: extract into dbfarm
steps.cmd: tar -C /var/monetdb5/dbfarm -xf /backups/lab-hot.tar --transform 's,^lab/,lab_snap/,' --transform 's,^lab$,lab_snap,' && chown -R monetdb:monetdb /var/monetdb5/dbfarm/lab_snap 2>/dev/null; monetdb release lab_snap >/dev/null 2>&1; true

steps.name: destroy snapshot db
steps.cmd: monetdb stop lab_snap >/dev/null 2>&1; monetdb destroy -f lab_snap

hot_snapshot.description: server-side consistent tar restored under a new name
